title: Authentication change line
description: Extensive checks for any change that touches authentication, sessions, guards, API keys, permissions or impersonation. Triggered automatically by factory-line-router (verify --full) when a diff enters the territory in triggers.json; S3 must be green for the exact tree before the work is done.

stations.title: Map the auth surface
stations.description: Static: route security inventory holds (app.module.spec, Jest --ci), no route weaker than on the merge base, no role gained a permission, no dangerous auth pattern added. Weakenings must be acknowledged in security-acks.json.

stations.title: Unit-prove the auth territory
stations.description: Every spec in the auth territory passes and auth source changes ship with a spec change.

stations.title: Attack the live slot
stations.description: Live probes against the slot API: JWT forgery matrix, security-token sign-in and rotation, inventory-driven sweep of every authenticated route (anonymous, forged, bogus API key), impersonation and cross-user isolation.

extraStages.description: auth-change S1: route/permission weakening + dangerous pattern scan
auth-change S3: live attack probes on the slot API

handoff.waitFor: human security review of the S1 report and any new security-acks.json entry before merge

traveler.note: Paste the gate summary (har line status auth-change) and the S1 weakening list into the PR; .har/runs is local evidence.

prototypeNotes: Territory is declared in triggers.json (paths, Prisma models, specs) — a repo-local extension read by factory-line-router, not part of the line contract.
Stages import .har/stages/lib/factory-line.mjs, shipped by the factory-line-router plugin (declared in plugins[]).
auth-e2e creates a throwaway user and account in the slot DB and deletes them at the end.
